content: अव्युत्पन्न {%a.%} .²1 Not proficient, inexperienced, not practised, ignorant; अव्युत्पन्नो बालभावः <ls>K. 196</ls>. .²2 Having no proper or regular derivation (as a word) (अवयवार्थशून्य), उणादयोऽव्युत्पन्नानि प्रातिपदिकानि. .{@-न्नः@} A person not versed in the grammar, idiom <ab>&c.</ab> of a language, a smattering or superficial linguist (शब्दावयवार्थानभिज्ञोऽवैयाकरणः <ls>Mbh.</ls> on <ls n="P.">1. 1. 51.</ls>).
